text:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout for v2 header-normalize across us, eu, apac starting in 20m. Canary @ 3% then 10% then 50%. auto-rollback on 5xx spike > 2x baseline or latency p95 > 1.5x for 10m
sam: Heads up — we still have a subset of mobile SDKs pinning to v1. Do we have a pin-exclusion list?
neha: @sam yes. I uploaded the tenant list to the deploybot pinlist earlier. Mobile EU tenants are the main holdouts. Recommend exclusion for EU mobile for first 24h.
toni: We need release notes to call out the breaking header case normalization for clients using custom routing. Can someone add a short blurb to the release notes now?
liam: Rollback criteria: besides deploy-bot thresholds, ops wants an explicit manual rollback gate if client errors > 0.5% for a single tenant for 15m. Can we add tenant-level alerting?
deploy-bot: Accepted. Added tenant-alert rule: if tenant_5xx_rate > 0.5% for 15m -> page oncall and trigger canary-hold. Auto-rollback unchanged.
ops-bot: Canary metrics snapshot (2m ago):
```
region: eu, canary: 3%, p95: 98ms, 5xx: 0.02%
region: us, canary: 3%, p95: 102ms, 5xx: 0.01%
```
no anomalies so far.
sam: OK can we pin by header-signal so old SDKs keep hitting v1? I want a quick toggle to opt out tenants flagged as mobile-old-sdk.
neha: We can set header gate `X-Client-Version` check. Quick snippet for route matcher: ```match: if headers['X-Client-Version'] < '2.0.0' -> route: v1``` deploy-bot can apply.
liam: Add to rollout plan: exclude header-pin tenants + exclude EU mobile region for first 24h. Also create a rollback-runbook link in the deploy message.
toni: I'll update release notes now and add a 'migration steps' section for SDK owners. Will ping docs once done. :memo:
sam: Who's owning the post-rollout client telemetry check at T+3h? I'll take the first 3h window. Will check for tenant spikes and schema regressions.
neha: I'll monitor logs and coordinate with ops for tenant-level paging. If we see any mobile SDK regressions, we cut EU mobile and escalate.
deploy-bot: Plan updated: exclude list applied to header-pin tenants, EU mobile excluded for 24h, canary schedule unchanged. Rolling in 10m unless a manual hold is requested. :rocket:
liam: Approved from eng-ops. Let's hold manual if any questions before the 10m mark.
toni: Release notes link: https://redwood.internal/relnotes/v2-header-normalize — added migration tips.
sam: good. setting a manual hold for 4 tenants flagged in the pinlist (added comment).
neha: ack. I'll wait for your go before flipping the EU exclusion if you need it earlier.
deploy-bot: Deploy started. Canary @ 3% now. Notifying #oncall and posting telemetry to the rollout dashboard. :eyes:
